title: Hyderabad hackathon — local ops & expense notebook
content:
Purpose: quick pocket notebook for on-the-ground ops, receipts, and vendor handoffs during Hyderabad hackathon (Aug 15–16). Low-fi, living doc — update as we go.

Key dates/times:
- Team arrival window: Aug 14 evening (checkin at Hotel Kosi, 7–10pm).
- Setup slot (venue): Aug 15, 06:30–09:30 — AV & tables in main hall.
- Doors open: Aug 15, 09:30. Talks/mentor hours: 10:00–16:00.
- Strike: Aug 16, 18:00–20:00 (we pay overtime if needed).

Primary venue contact:
- Ramesh K. (Venue Manager, Kosi Convention Centre) — +91 98401 22334 (WhatsApp). Onsite at 06:00 on 8/15. Door code for loading bay: 4281 (confirm once).

AV & staging:
- SafeSound AV — Ajay Sharma — +91 99451 88776 — quoted \u20B920,500 for 2 days (PA, 2 mics, 1 wireless lapel, projector + on-site tech).
- On-site tech name (day-of): Ajay (same number) — schedule check-in 06:45.
- Backup: EventRent Hyderabad — +91 87900 33211 (flat hourly).

Catering / snacks:
- CaterQuick Hyderabad — contact: Anjali Verma — catering@caterquick.in / +91 88833 44556 — estimated \u20B94,200 for 200 tea/snack packs (vegn/veg+gluten-free labels).
- Lunch boxes (optional): Veg/Non-veg split 60/40. Confirm menu by Aug 8.
- Invoice preference: email + hard copy on-site. Ask for GST invoice to bill to Redwood India team.

Local transport & petty cash:
- MetroTaxi Prepaid (preferred for short runs) — driver Priyank (cell: +91 91234 11004). Approx fares: airport->hotel \u20B91,000, hotel->venue \u20B9300.
- Ola/Uber approximate surge windows: 08:00–10:00 and 18:00–20:00 — plan for pooling.
- Petty cash float: \u20B95,000 (kept in event pouch at concierge). Cash log: take photo of receipt and append to Slack thread #hyd-ops-receipts.
- UPI IDs for vendors (if they accept): caterquick@axis, safesound@okaxis, metrotaxi@upi — verify on-site before sending.

Badges, printing & swag:
- BadgeForge — contact: Neha Kapoor — +91 99070 55612 — on-site print kiosk for replacements (price: \u20B920 per badge).
- Swag vendor (stickers + shirts): PrintPulse — Raj — +91 77006 22119 — confirm sizes by Aug 6.

Expense categorization (use code on expense form):
- TRAVEL_LOCAL: taxis, prepaid rides, poke allowances
- VENUE_RENTAL: venue fees, loading bay, security
- CATERING: snacks, lunch, coffee
- AUDIO_VISUAL: AV vendor and backup hires
- SWAG: shirts, stickers, promo items
- MISC_PETTY: emergency purchases (cable ties, tape, batteries)

Receipt & reimbursement process (short):
1) Take clear photo of every receipt.
2) Upload to Slack #hyd-ops-receipts thread with: date, payer, expense code (see categories), approximate INR amount.
3) For payments by card/company CC — forward the digital invoice to finance@redwood.ai with subject "EVENTS-2987 HYD — vendor name — date".
4) For cash/UPI reimbursements — one person (Maya) will collate and submit single expense report at end of event. Reimbursements processed in India payroll cycle (allow 2–3 pay periods).
5) Emergency bank transfers: use Expense code EMG, get offline signoff via Slack DM from Jorge or Priya.

On-site supplies checklist (pack this in red duffel):
- 6x power strips + 3m extension cords
- 2x HDMI adapters (USB-C->HDMI)
- Label maker + gaffer tape + cable ties
- Small tool kit (screwdriver set, scissors)
- Printed badge sheets (50 backup)
- First aid kit + hand sanitizer
- Petty cash envelope (\u20B95,000) + ledger pad

Points of friction / open Qs:
- Confirm whether Hotel Kosi requires an additional vendor KYC for CaterQuick (action: Priya to confirm by Aug 5).
- Confirm loading bay hours and whether we can pre-stage equipment night before (Ramesh answer pending).
- AV backup cost if Ajay is unavailable — agree fallback cap of \u20B98,000 (Jorge to pre-approve).

Day-of staffing notes (roles):
- Ops lead: Maya (overall vendor liaison, receipts collector).
- AV lead: Jorge (runs tech checks, PTZ camera setup).
- Volunteer coordinator: Priya (badge desk + mentor hospitality).
- Floater: Arun (run errands, cash courier).

Emergency contacts (local):
- Nearest hospital: Continental Care Clinic — +91 40 2333 2211 (2.4 km from venue).
- On-duty security (Kosi): Sanjay — extension 5 (on-call).

Post-event wrap & deliverables (timeline):
- Aug 16 night: preliminary spend tally + scanned receipts uploaded by 23:59.
- Aug 18: full expense sheet emailed to finance (code EVENTS-2987).
- Aug 20: lessons-learned quick 30-min sync (record notes into Confluence page).

Quick SOPs (reminders):
- Always ask for GST invoice if spend > \u20B95,000 and flag to finance team.
- For UPI payments, request confirmation screenshot + collect vendor phone number and GSTIN (if available).
- If we pay cash for anything > \u20B92,000 note a witness and sign the petty cash ledger.

On-site Slack channels to use:
- #hyd-ops (ops coordination)
- #hyd-ops-receipts (receipt uploads only)
- DM Maya for urgent approvals (no approvals in main channels for cash unless Jorge is offline)

Random quick notes (capture live):
- Mentor arrival window: 09:30–10:00 — table #M2 reserved for mentor check-in.
- Charging station idea: set up 1 long table near entrance with 6 surge strips + signage. Label chargers as \"Redwood chargers — pick up badge\".
- Volunteers: request 8 total (2 badge, 2 hospitality, 2 AV assistants, 2 floaters).

To-do (next 5 actions):
- [ ] Priya: confirm CaterQuick GST invoice + menu options (by Aug 5).
- [ ] Jorge: AV runbook & backup quote from EventRent (by Aug 7).
- [ ] Maya: prepare petty cash envelope and ledger (by Aug 13 evening).
- [ ] Arun: confirm pickup times with BadgeForge and PrintPulse (by Aug 10).

Notes-to-self:
- Keep receipts organized by day and payer (makes the finance spreadsheet way easier).
- If a vendor gives a handwritten receipt, get phone number and send a quick acknowledgement email requesting a GST invoice.

End of notebook — update live on the plane if anything else comes up.
